           MENISPERMUM CANADENSE

         Moonseed

        (MENISPERMUM)


A remedy for megrim, associated with restlessness and dreams. Pain in
        spine. Dryness, itching all over. Dry mouth and throat.



Head.--  Pressure   from within outward  ,
        with   stretching and yawning   and pain down back. Sick
        headache; pain in forehead and temples, moving to occiput. Tongue swollen and much saliva.



Extremities.--  Pain in back, thighs, elbows, shoulders. Legs
        sore, as if bruised.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Cocculus;
        Bryon  .



Dose.--  Third potency.
